citation.quoted_text: Clarience Technologies, LLC (8)(10) | Class A Units ( 2,666 units) | 2/12/2024 | 6,557 | 6,557 | 0.2 | %

rationale: Class 2 within-row adjudication. The flagged row matches table 16 row 3, and table 16 row 30 totals 7,079,994 cost and 7,244,282 fair value, which is the comparative-period schedule total. The current-period SOI total is table 11 row 39 at 7,172,247 cost and 7,356,032 fair value. Retaining the table 16 comparative row under report_date 2025-03-31 is therefore a real comparative-period leak, not a false alarm.
